title: Deux visages de L'Astrée (first critical edition of Honoré d'Urfé's L'Astrée)
institution: Eglal Henein (Tufts University; died 2021); hosted since 2025 by the Université de Rouen-Normandie (Presses universitaires de Rouen et du Havre)
author: Honoré d'Urfé
notes: Web edition, begun in 2007, of the four parts of L'Astrée in two versions: a faithful critical text (reference editions of 1621 for parts I-III and of 1624 for part IV) and a 'functional' version in more modern French, with variants, notes, indexes and illustrations; the preliminary editions of 1607, 1610 and 1619 are also online. Figures: 890,559 words is the total given in the project's own word-frequency workbook (dictionnaire.xlsx, derived from Étienne Brunet's Hyperbase) for the four parts: 210,736, 245,178, 302,955 and 131,690 words. The 4 texts are the four parts; the three preliminary editions are not counted. The author died in 2021; the site moved to the University of Rouen in March 2025 and its news page records a change in June 2026. A downloadable Word version of the functional edition is offered.
